lead: Rohit Sharma is best known as an Indian cricketer, born on 30 April 1987 in Nagpur.
As of 2026, he is 39 years old, and his birth date places him under the Taurus sign.
He has represented India national cricket team and Mumbai cricket team and has been recognised with Arjuna Award and Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in Sports and Games.
Below you will find a verified overview of Rohit Sharma: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.
